Introducing Free at Sea Plus™ Upgrade from Free at Sea™ to Free at Sea Plus™ for just $49.99 per person, per day.

The Unlimited Open Bar package can be purchased onboard in the first two days of the cruise for $45/per person/per day + 20% gratuity + taxes and fees.

Cover charges are as follows: Steak, Teppanyaki / Hasuki, French, and Seafood have a $60 cover charge. Brazil, Asian, Food Republic, and Sushi have a $50 cover charge. Italian, BBQ, Pincho, and Mexican have a $40 cover charge.

upgraded Wi-Fi packages are still available for purchase: Voyage Wi-Fi Pass (1.5MBPS) for $29.99 per stateroom per day. Streaming Voyage Wi-Fi Pass for $39.99 per stateroom per day. Additional devices may be added for $14.99 per device per day
